entries.title: A crewmate that reads strangers' words works inside a fence
entries.body: When a task reads words anyone can write, such as your project's issues and pull requests, your first mate can start its crewmate as an outside reader. That crewmate has no shell, no web and no browser, reads only its own project's files and its own project where it lives, and gets everything it reads there marked as words from outside. Every change it asks to make where your project lives waits on one approval card, a ticked row for each, and nothing is sent until you choose Only this time.

picture.alt: An approval card listing two writes an outside reader asked to send to GitHub, each a ticked row with its call and the request it sends
